description: Tracks active open-source AI agent repositories from GitHub signals.

items.description: The agent that grows with you

Open-source AI job search agent and job finder: scan job boards, score each job 1-5 against your CV before you apply, tailor an ATS-friendly resume and cover letter, get interview prep and an application tracker. It helps you fill in each application; you press Submit. Runs locally in Codex, OpenCode and other AI CLIs, or as a Claude Code plugin.
Open-source Rust coding agent for terminal, web, and desktop. Any model, multi-agent fleets, MCP & plugins, OS sandboxing, and session receipts.
⌥ Coding agent with the IDE wired in. Built by Stencil Labs.
Scale computer-use 2.0 with open-source drivers, cross-OS sandboxes, and benchmarks for training, evaluation, and data generation.
dsh-go — DeepSeek Harness 装进口袋：手机本机运行，也能遥控你的电脑。
Consider it done. The open-source AI agent that works out of the box · 想到，就能做到。开源、开箱即用的 AI Agent。
A persistent workspace for development work that self-improves and continues beyond one session.

Open source personal agent with its own computer. It chases invoices, preps your calls and cancels trials on real websites, and asks before it acts. Runs on your machine with the model you choose. By n8n.
Open-source desktop AI agent for tools, files, knowledge, workflows, and real deliverables.
The micro-VM for AI agents — light enough to embed on your laptop, elastic enough to power an agentic cloud.
Browser-native side panel for Hermes Agent — connect web context to your local Hermes runtime.
Okou connects to the tools your team already uses and does the work — across marketing, sales, engineering, and operations, under your control.

Open-source GrokBot alternative built on DeepSeek Harness. Build your personal bot team: multiple personal agents with persistent memory, identities and permissions, extensible through DSH plugins.｜基于 DeepSeek Harness 的开源 GrokBot 平替：有长期记忆的个人 AI Bot 团队，支持多 Bot 协作、身份权限与插件生态扩展。MIT.
Non-invasive MCP accelerator plugin for Google Antigravity (CLI/Desktop/IDE): cuts LLM turns (-34%), token quota (-31%), and upload traffic (-40%) without affecting native UI or diffs.
